title: Completeness from stratified perfect models
statement: Let X be a Noetherian scheme [def-pc-scheme], A a commutative Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] that is adically complete for an ideal I [def-weil-pbc-adically-complete-ring], with I the unique maximal ideal, and let K be a completed-coefficient derived object satisfying IsSfbStratifiedPerfect [def-sfb-adic-stratified-perfect-data]. Then K is IsSfbAdicComplete.

lean.statement:
theorem adicPerfectModels_completeness (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian X]
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    (I : Ideal A) (hI : I.IsMaximal ∧ ∀ J : Ideal A, J.IsMaximal → J = I)
    [IsAdicComplete I A]
    (K : DerivedCategory (proEtaleRingModules X (adicLisseCompletedRing X I)))
    (hK : IsSfbStratifiedPerfect X I K) :
    IsSfbAdicComplete X I K

proof.text: Unpack IsSfbStratifiedPerfect to obtain the fixed finite stratification, covering sieves, and completed finite-projective models. For each P, its strict lower and upper bounds give the degreewise IsZero hypotheses of [lem-sfb-adic-perfect-model-complete-reduction]; swap the recorded projective/finite pair into the order required there. Take the completeness conjunct of HasCompleteResidueCalculation.

Apply the reverse direction of [lem-sfb-perfect-model-completion-transport] to obtain IsSfbAdicComplete for each global sfbCompletedModel. The original stratified-perfect witness supplies the local isomorphism between K and this complete object on its specified stratum and covering arrow.
Use [lem-sfb-adic-complete-stratum-gluing] on these complete comparison objects and the original local isomorphisms. This concludes IsSfbAdicComplete X I K without changing its statement.
